source_policy: Derived statistics only; original Softimage assets are not committed.

aligned_role_words.interpretation: The previous u16le reads beginning at +87/+89 straddled the actual aligned big-endian words at +86/+88. The +87 read happens to equal +86 in all 664 records because the adjacent +88 high byte is zero. The +89 read equals +88 in only 610/664 records because it consumes the first byte of the +90 matrix on rotated records. The coarse role classification happened to remain unchanged in 664/664 records, but the old field values are not valid binary boundaries and have been replaced by aligned +86/+88 decoding.

special_mode_policy: Codes 7 and 8 occur only on material-level relation-code-401 edges in the resolved archival scenes and carry identity +6/+90 in those linked examples. Code 7 is associated with chrome/reflection picture families and code 8 with cavern on glass materials. Preserve them as special material texture modes rather than forcing them through geometric UV generation until the exact legacy enum names/semantics are authoritative.
